title: WZRD Adventurer Bags XL Inventory
content:
Em May’s WZRD Bikes in Canada just dropped a selection of the brand’s Adventurer Bags XL with a variety of colorways. These bags are designed to sit close to the body, either on the shoulder or cross-body – they are bags that encourage movement. Biking, hiking, fishing, and everything in between. A secondary stabilization strap is included so the bag doesn’t spin around your body. It doesn’t matter if you’re bending over to pick something up or riding around town – these bags won’t budge! The stabilization strap has a magnetic buckle, so you can get the bag spun around and opened up with one hand – while on the move.

Waterproof fabrics and waterproof zippers keep your contents safe even in an atmospheric river.

There’s a full run at WZRD right now, so roll on over and check them out. FYI, the new Canadian tariffs on our neighbors to the north add ~$ 70 CAD to the order, but even with the add-on, these are well worth the price.
